strongest_angle: Examining how mechanical friction within the drive module of Tandem Diabetes Care's Mobi insulin pumps triggers false occlusion alarms and 230 adverse events across 80,000 units.

key_facts.fact: Tandem Diabetes Care initiated a recall and correction for more than 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps starting on September 23, 2026.
Increased friction within the pump's drive module reduces available motor power, causing the system to incorrectly detect an occlusion and suspend insulin delivery.
Tandem Diabetes Care received 230 reports of adverse events requiring medical intervention linked to the false occlusion alarms.
